description: Real merged migrations in public repositories, frozen before scoring. Ground truth is the set of lines developers removed that use the changed API.
selection_rules: Merged public pull requests, in GitHub search result order for the listed queries.
First 10 qualifying per migration, one per repository, at most 150 examined.
Must remove more non-comment lines using the changed API than it adds.
Excludes forks, the library's own organization, repositories over 200 MB, and paths the analyzer ignores by policy.
Excludes every repository in the tuning set; selected before any fix was scored on it.

migrations.description: Selenium 4 removed the find_element(s)_by_* driver methods.
NumPy 1.24 removed the np.float style builtin aliases.
React 18 replaced ReactDOM.render and hydrate with the root API.
openai-node v4 removed OpenAIApi and its create* methods.
